ticket.title: benchwork chat context injection reads the ledger directly and goes blank in records mode
ticket.description:
Found while sweeping for consumers of storypole state after ADR 0009 moved tickets into one file each. context_injector.rs:61 reads .gaugeblock/storypole/ledger.jsonl and replays it to inject task context into the chat harness. In records mode that file still exists - init creates it - but holds no events, so the injection yields nothing and the failure is silent: the chat simply has no task context, which looks like a quiet model rather than a broken reader. It needs to read whichever layout the store uses, the same way storypole workspace rollup now does (SP-36): tickets/*.json when the tickets directory exists, ledger.jsonl otherwise. Worth noting what did NOT break: capabilities.rs:100 checks ledger.is_file() OR config.toml, so storypole_active stays true, and outfeed reaches storypole through add_task/verify_task rather than the file, so it needs no change.

FIXED 2026-11-08 (commit 9da4787, benchmark main).

The chat harness now reads state through storypole_core::state::load, so it sees whichever layout the store uses.

Worse than the ticket said: the old code grepped ledger.jsonl for status-change lines, so even in ledger mode it
counted EVENTS rather than current states - a ticket that moved to in_progress and back still counted as in progress.
In records mode it found no ledger and reported zero of everything, which reads as a quiet project rather than a
broken reader.

This is the first caller of the loader added in GB-348, which is the point of that ticket: a consumer asks for state
and never chooses a file.

Tier 2: 50 benchwork-core tests green, clippy clean, audits pass.
